Don't miss out on this week's episode of 'Ask the Editor!'

Join **Mehdi** and **Prem** for a live Q&A on **Monday** at **11am ET, 8am PT,
or 4pm GMT** to break down the latest stories. Subscribers can join the
conversation on [Zeteo.com](https://open.substack.com/live-
stream/147866?utm_source=post-publish), the Substack app, or
[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K2WTc8Xlq3o).

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**Zeteo 's** editor-in-chief will unpack the latest chaos from Donald Trump's
war on Iran (including a possible ground invasion!), Israel's lawless violence
in the West Bank and further invasion into Lebanon - and whatever news you're
asking about.
